responsibility: This header declares the pushback input abstraction used by the mc-boot runtime's text-processing tools. It exports file opening and closing, character and string pushback, stream consumption, warning/error reporting with source positions, debug toggling, and current line/column queries, defining the public scanner-support interface above FIO.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public interface for GPushBackInput: it declares the open/read/pushback/diagnostic and position-query operations, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GPushBackInput.cc contains the actual stack storage, line-counting, and error-reporting implementation.
